verdict.rationale: Firebase's own Cloud Firestore docs have a dedicated vector-search page covering both parts of the story: storing vector values and running K-nearest neighbor (KNN) similarity searches, backed by KNN vector indexes you create and manage. missing for 10: details on distance measures, filtering, and scale limits, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of vector search in practice.

support.subject: As a developer, I can store embeddings and run vector similarity search for AI features

citations.quote: This page shows you how to use Cloud Firestore to perform K-nearest neighbor (KNN) vector searches using the following techniques: Store vector values, Create and manage KNN vector indexes
